entries.clue: Rubber sandal held on by a toe post, slapping at every step
Drifting slab of frozen sea a beset ship may be pinned among
Deep-bowled shovel that lifts a pile of pick-and-mix from the bin
Short-handled digging blade: plastic on the beach, steel in the garden.
Leisurely seafront stroll, or the long paved strip you take it along.
Hidden split in a glacier, bridged over by treacherous drifted snow
Tall glass sweet-shop vessel, lifted down and tipped over the counter
Rectangle of terry cloth to lie on, dry off with, then shake out for hours
Dog-driving Norwegian who reached 90 degrees south five weeks ahead
What a square does when held too long in a warm palm
Gritty crushed fragment of the bean, milled into a dark flowing paste
Runnered load-carrier hauled by dog teams or by men in harness
